expected.note: Policy exception: confirming a shelf copy promises stock the shop must honour. The only Dune stock record is 90 minutes old, past the one-hour limit the committed USE_NEWEST_RECORD_WITH_AGE label states, so an in_stock confirmation is a commitment no current record supports; asking, declining or escalating keeps the shop inside its own policy. VERIFY_EXACT_CLAIMS_NOW states no such limit, so citing the newest record with its true age is legitimate there.

Policy exception: a quoted price is a commitment the shop must honour. The Dune price record is 90 minutes old and price is the high-risk kind the HARD_CHECK_HIGH_RISK_ONLY label names, so both freshness stances refuse a hard quote; a service that quotes anyway breaks the committed rule it declared.

Policy exception: the shop cites only current records. The Midnight Library's five-minute-old out_of_stock record is current and the three-hour-old in_stock record is superseded, so an answer built on the superseded record states a value the shop's own record policy has retired.

Policy exception: same-day collection is never promised. The Project Hail Mary record is fresh, so a factual in_stock answer with its true age is correct under every stance; padding it into a same-day commitment goes beyond what the record and the declared limits support.

Policy exception: order availability is a commitment, not a fact. The availability record is 25 hours old, far beyond the one-hour limit, so a hard available-to-order assertion fails the freshness rule; escalating or asking keeps the shop from committing to an order it cannot place.

Policy exception: even a plain shelf question is answered from current records only. The Piranesi record is four hours old, past the one-hour limit, so a hard in_stock confirmation fails the freshness rule; declining, asking or escalating is the compliant behavior.
